spec.description: Is the server healthy, is the site answering, is anything logging errors? Provisioned from deploy/config/monitoring/grafana/dashboards - edit there.

spec.title: CPU by mode
spec.description: steal = the hypervisor gave the CPU to another guest; iowait = waiting for the disk.

spec.title: Network (host interfaces)
spec.description: From cAdvisor's root cgroup: Alloy's node exporter runs in a container and would only see the container's own interfaces. Outgoing traffic is drawn below zero.

spec.title: Memory
spec.description: 1 - MemAvailable / MemTotal: page cache does not count as used. Alert above 90 %.

spec.title: Memory per service
spec.description: Working set = what counts against the service's memory limit.

spec.title: 5xx ratio
spec.description: Alert above 5 % for 5 minutes (only with traffic).

spec.title: Latency p95 / p50
spec.description: Estimated from Traefik's histogram buckets (0.1, 0.3, 1.2, 5 s), so it moves in steps.

spec.title: Certificate expires in
spec.description: The host name whose certificate expires first. Traefik renews 30 days ahead, so anything below 30 means renewals are failing. Alert below 14 days. Per name the NEWEST certificate counts: Traefik keeps exporting a replaced certificate until it restarts (traefik/traefik#8606).

spec.title: Log lines by stack and level
spec.description: Level as detected by Loki from the JSON / logfmt field "level".

spec.title: Recent ERROR / WARN lines
spec.description: Containers and host journal, newest first. For context open the Logs dashboard.

spec.title: Alerts that need attention
spec.description: Firing, pending, no-data and error states of the provisioned rules (folder Betula alerts). This list does not depend on any notification channel: it is the place to look while e-mail (SMTP) is not wired. Empty = all rules are healthy.

spec.title: Betula overview
